title: Sega Ages: I Love Mickey Mouse: Fushigi no Oshiro Daibouken & I Love Donald Duck: Georgia Ou no Hihou
native_title: セガエイジス アイ・ラブ・ミッキー・マウス ～ふしぎのお城 大冒険～ ／ アイ・ラブ・ドナルド・ダック ～グルジア王の秘宝～
overview: Sega Ages: I Love Mickey Mouse: Fushigi no Oshiro Daibouken & I Love Donald Duck: Gurujia Ou no Hihou is a video game compilation for the Sega Saturn. Its extraordinarily long name comes from the fact it contains two games, both originally released as separate Sega Mega Drive games.
